messages.subject: factor correlations
parts:
Hi Phil, 

Hope you are well. 

I tried estimated a model but the summary did not show the factor correlations. Am I missing something? Do I have to extract the factor scores before running a correlation? 

 
Kind regards,
Aiden



rsq.cfa.mirt.model.COV <- mirt.model(' bis_rsq= 1-7
                    bas_rsq= 8-13
                    fight_rsq= 14-19
                    flight_rsq= 20-24
                    freeze_rsq= 25-29
                    COV = bas_rsq*flight_rsq, bas_rsq*flight_rsq, bas_rsq*freeze_rsq, fight_rsq*flight_rsq, fight_rsq*flight_rsq, flight_rsq*freeze_rsq')

rsq.fit.c.mirt.COV <- mirt(gray.rsq.ordered, rsq.cfa.mirt.model.COV, itemtype="gpcm", method="MHRM")
summary(rsq.fit.c.mirt.COV)

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: factor correlations
parts:
Hi Aiden,

Unfortunately this was a printout bug, which someone reported a while back as well. It's harmless since the correlations are really there (use coef()), but summary was modified and accidental omitted them. The fix is on the dev version, or just wait a few days when I release the next update to CRAN. Cheers.

Phil
